enhance.title: Page Enhancements
enhance.detail: Session delete, export, project move, Timeline, user scripts and more
enhance.masterSwitchDetail: When disabled, all enhancements (delete, export, move, Timeline, plugins, menu placement) are stopped.
enhance.compatModeDetail: Suitable for official login or official mixed API Key; retains session delete, export, project move, Timeline and user scripts; plugin entry enhancements disabled.
enhance.fullModeDetail: Suitable for Pure API; enables plugin entry, forced install, session delete/export, project move, and all page capabilities.
enhance.compatHint: Currently in compatible enhancement mode; plugin marketplace unlock, forced unlock, and special plugin forced install are not enabled; other features still work.
enhance.generalHint: In official or official mixed API mode, plugin marketplace unlock, forced unlock, and special plugin forced install are usually not needed.
enhance.pluginMarketplaceDetail: Extends API Key mode plugin marketplace requests to show full plugin list; usually not needed in official/mixed mode.
enhance.forceUnlockDetail: Restores unlock method from 1.1.9, forces plugin entry to display and enable.
enhance.forcePluginInstallDetail: Removes 'App unavailable' restrictions on frontend plugin installation.
enhance.modelWhitelistDetail: Fetches models from environment variables and /v1/models to patch into the model list.
enhance.serviceTierDetail: Shows service tier toggle buttons (Standard / Fast / Priority).
enhance.sessionDeleteDetail: Shows delete button on session list hover with undo support.
enhance.markdownExportDetail: Shows export button on session list for timestamped Markdown export.
enhance.projectMoveDetail: Move sessions to normal conversation or other local projects.
enhance.timelineDetail: Shows user question timeline on the right side with summaries and jump navigation.
enhance.conversationWidthDetail: Limits main conversation and input to a fixed max width for large screen reading.
enhance.scrollRestoreDetail: Restores last scroll position when switching threads.
enhance.zedRemoteDetail: Remote SSH file references can be opened directly with Zed Remote Development.
enhance.upstreamWorktreeDetail: Create Git worktree from latest upstream branch.
enhance.nativeMenuDetail: Insert Codex++ menu into Codex top native menu bar.

sessions.localSessionsDetail: Displayed in reverse update time order
sessions.noSessions: No local sessions found, or state_5.sqlite does not exist.

scripts.localScriptsDetail: Built-in, manual & market scripts; enable/disable or delete user scripts here

settings.title: Basic Settings

mode.fullDetail: Suitable for Pure API; enables plugin entry, forced install, session delete/export, project move, and all page capabilities.
relay.syncDetail: Can mix providers and use sync operations for quick setup.
settings.launchArgsDetail: Appended after default CDP params. Leave empty for default launch behavior.
settings.extraArgsHint: One argument per line, e.g. --force_high_performance_gpu. No need to include 'open' or '--args'.

providerSync.syncedTo: Synced to {{target}}: fixed {{sessions}} session file(s), updated {{rows}} index row(s){{skipped}}.
providerSync.failed: History sessions fix failed; check error prompt and retry.
provider.modeOfficialDesc: This provider switches to official login mode, uses the ChatGPT official account, does not write API Key.
provider.modeMixedDesc: This provider keeps official login mode and mixes requests with current API Key; page enhancements still use compatible mode.
provider.modePureApiDesc: This provider writes to both config.toml and auth.json; API Key is also injected into the provider bearer token.
provider.switchOfficial: Switched to official login; page enhancements set to compatible mode.
provider.switchPureApi: Switched to Pure API; page enhancements set to full enhancement mode.
provider.switchMixed: Switched to official login with mixed API Key; page enhancements set to compatible mode.
provider.notAuthenticated: Not currently logged in with an official account.
provider.notConfigured: Current provider does not have complete config.toml / API Key archive.
provider.pureApiReady: Pure API ready: will write to both config.toml and auth.json.
provider.notAuthenticatedNoKey: Not logged in with official account, and no mixed API Base URL / Key configured.
provider.notAuthenticatedMixed: Not logged in with official account; mixed API Key requires an official login first.
provider.noMixedFields: No mixed API Base URL / Key configured yet.
provider.mixedReady: Official login ready: {{account}}; will mix with current API Key.
provider.officialNotLoggedIn: Not logged in with official account; switching to official login mode requires logging in via Codex/ChatGPT first.
provider.pureApiNotWritten: Pure API config not fully written: check that this provider has OPENAI_API_KEY and config.toml contains model_provider/provider/base_url.
provider.noApiFiles: Current provider does not have a complete config.toml / API Key archive.
